title: Reservation disclosure
description: Expand a compact reservation into editable details within the same visual anchor.
useCase: Expand a compact reservation into editable details within the same visual anchor.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Inline disclosure, not a modal or real booking service; no focus trap is needed because surrounding content stays interactive.
look: Light sage-grey page with a single white rounded card: a small green-toned room illustration, dark title, muted date line and a sage plus icon.
motion: Clicking the card expands its booking details downward by animating grid rows from 0fr to 1fr over 260 ms ease-out while the plus rotates 45° into a close mark.
adapt: Expansion is the `booking-details` `grid-template-rows` transition (260ms `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)`) toggled by `open`, with `inert` disabling collapsed controls; `plus` rotates over 240ms. Replace the room summary, guest stepper and price with your content.
